# Threat Model Template

## Scope

Describe the system, feature, data, and boundaries under review.

## Assets

List sensitive data, credentials, operational controls, and business-critical behavior.

## Actors

List expected users, administrators, services, and potential attackers.

## Trust boundaries

Describe network, API, persistence, identity, and third-party boundaries.

## Threats

Identify abuse cases, privacy risks, injection risks, access risks, and availability risks.

## Mitigations

Map mitigations to threats and owners.

## Open risks

Record accepted or unresolved risks.
